				<div class="hotel_description_short">
					Facing the sea and under the shade of an immense coconut grove, BGK offers its customers hospitality, harmony and adventure. The Pousada integrates the typical and natural characteristics of the regio<span class="hotel_description_more">Read more</span>
				</div>
				<div class="hotel_description_long">
					Facing the sea and under the shade of an immense coconut grove, BGK offers its customers hospitality, harmony and adventure. The Pousada integrates the typical and natural characteristics of the region with excellence in services and attendance. BGK is for the outdoorsy. Pousada BGK is located in Barra Grande, Piauí, in front of Barra Grande beach. The property has a kitesurfing school, swimming pool, bar restricted to guests, a large garden and a restaurant open to the public. All chalets include Split air conditioning, hot water and minibar. The property is 60 km from Parnaíba and its bus station and 7 km from ecological tours. During your stay, you can enjoy a daily breakfast buffet with assorted seasonal fruits, breads and cold meats. In addition, guests can enjoy regional specialties and a selection of drinks at the guest house's restaurant.
				</div>
			</div>

Once the repentance period has expired, for change/cancellation requests up to 30 days before check-in, 100% of the amount paid will be refunded, if it was made via deposit/transfer/pix. If it has been carried out via credit card, the amount paid will be refunded minus the cost of the card operator. For requests up to 15 days before check in, due to the COVID-19 pandemic or lockdown, 100% of the amount paid will be credited for future accommodation, without refund (Law No. 14,046, 08/24/2020). After this period, supported by decree 7381/10 articles 20, we will deduct 30% of the total value of the contract on the amount already paid as irrecoverable expenses, and the remaining amount will be credits for a future reservation, without refund. Paragraph one: for cancellations within 24 hours of check-in, no-show or partial withdrawal of all contracted days, with the customer inside the hotel, no difference in the amount previously paid will be refunded. Full payment of daily rates will be required at the entrance of the hotel. (No show is characterized as the non-attendance of the customer on the stipulated date, without prior notice); 4th The right to claim for any clauses contained in this contract will expire in 30 days, counted from the reservation signal in the form of art. 26th item I of the consumer code. 5th The internal regulation, emails, proposals, reservation confirmation, rules, manual of good practices of COVID 19 and the notices posted in the sectors, which must be read and respected and the registration information sheet filled out are an integral part of this at the entrance of the hotel, which ones declare true under penalty of law; 6º The hotel reserves the right to prohibit the use of any area and/or equipment for preventive and/or corrective maintenance when necessary.
